_metadata.source: CGHS Office Memorandum and Delhi Government Health Scheme Guidelines
_metadata.notes: Rates are for semi-private ward. General ward -5%, Private ward +5%. Super-specialty +15%.

tier2.description: State capitals and major cities - 10% lower rates
tier2.source: CGHS Tier II city rates are 10% lower than Tier I

tier3.description: Smaller cities and towns - 20% lower rates
tier3.source: CGHS Tier III city rates are 20% lower than Tier I

nabh.description: National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers
nabh.notes: NABH rates are ~15% higher than non-NABH. Example: Lap Chole ₹33,000 (NABH) vs ₹28,050 (non-NABH)

nabl.description: National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories
nabl.notes: NABL accreditation treated same as NABH for billing purposes

jci.notes: International accreditation, premium higher than NABH

super_specialty.description: Super specialty hospitals (in addition to NABH)
super_specialty.notes: Super specialty hospitals may charge 15% higher than NABH rates for corresponding specialties

important_rules.room_multiplier_applicability: Room category adjustments apply ONLY to room rent and nursing charges. NEVER to implants, medicines, or consumables per NPPA guidelines.
important_rules.cghs_applicability: CGHS rates are applicable to empanelled hospitals. Private hospitals may charge higher to non-CGHS patients.
important_rules.package_inclusions: Package rates are inclusive of OT charges, anesthesia, routine investigations, nursing care for average length of stay.
